approvals.usual: {name} reads, searches and makes files by itself, and asks you first before it uses the internet, moves, deletes or sends anything.

approvals.changed.one: You changed one from the usual, marked with a dot.
approvals.changed.other: You changed {count} from the usual, each marked with a dot.

approvals.org.one: Your organization set one of these, marked with a lock.
approvals.org.other: Your organization set {count} of these, each marked with a lock.

approvals.parent: A parent chose these. To change one, ask them.
approvals.askText: {name} shows you what it will do, and waits.
approvals.neverText: {name} tells you it can’t, and why.
approvals.covers.read: Opening the files you gave {name}, or that it made, to read them
approvals.covers.edit: Writing a new file, or changing one {name} made or you gave it
approvals.covers.search: Looking something up, on the web or in your files
approvals.covers.execute: Working something out exactly, with a few lines of code
approvals.covers.fetch: Opening a web page, or reaching a site
approvals.covers.move: Putting a file somewhere else, or giving it another name
approvals.covers.other: Sending a message, sharing something, and anything else done through your services
approvals.covers.plan: Going ahead with a plan of several steps
approvals.folders: In a folder you gave {name}, it always shows you the change and asks first, whatever is chosen here, unless you said Always allow for that folder.
approvals.exceptionsText: What you allowed on a card, and what you made more careful
approvals.allowedNone: When {name} asks, Always allow keeps your answer here, to take back whenever you like.
approvals.carefulNone: Ask first, or never, for one kind of action or one service.
approvals.carefulText: For one kind of action or one service. It never allows more than the rest.
approvals.ifText: {name} asks itself this before each one. When it can’t tell, it counts as yes.
approvals.what.folder: {name} changes files in this folder without asking
approvals.what.films: Made without asking, though they cost more than pictures
approvals.what.meeting: These projects’ assistants may meet without asking
approvals.kept: Kept. You can take it back in Approvals.
approvals.certificatesText: This device’s seal, who dates certificates, and the public log
